source: ESA WorldCereal 2021 v100 (10 m), tiles by Terrascope (titiler.terrascope.be), zoom 3
rule: Zoom 3 is the service's own tiles, stacked. Below that, a pixel is coloured when at least 25% of the zoom-3 samples it covers are mapped as crops, in the colour of the most common class among them (ties: the more specific class).
